visible_text: 質問したときだけ Claude に送信

observation.happening: Dark toast notification dialog prompting user for consent to share screenshots with Claude. Icon on left, title in larger text, explanatory subtitle in smaller text, close button (X) on right.
observation.most_important: Permission/consent request for screenshot sharing — privacy-related system notification with clear action policy.
observation.next_action: User closes notification via X button or presumably acknowledges the permission setting.
anomalies: Very compact — full message fits in constrained toast height
Asymmetric layout with icon + text on left, X on right creates natural eye flow

ECAD.why: Clean, functional toast with excellent contrast and readable typography. Dark theme, proper whitespace, clear message hierarchy. However, the design is generic — rounded-corner dark toast with left icon + right close button is a standard pattern seen across many products (Claude, Slack, Discord, etc.). No distinctive craft or visual personality. Well-executed but not memorable.
